obtain ⟨hdp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  exact .cons (.ok (splitPre_of_derivePre k hdp)) (.cons hrl (.nil _))

/-! ## Library runs in the memory machine (§82 preamble, §82.7) -/

/-- Library runs from `LState.init statics` translated into the memory machine, with the contract
`K`, the deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters `π` fixed
once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82, §82.7): the initial state with the creations and writes of the
statics (as `SimRun.init`); then each `ok` library step, kernel steps and arena operations
interleaved, under the obligations of its kernel steps, followed by the raw operations of its
kernel steps. No invariant is assumed on the states of the run: they are library-reachable
(`LSimRun.lreach`), so the kernel invariant holds on them (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
inductive LSimRun {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Ty) :
    LState → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (LState.init statics) (minit π statics)
  | step {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} {s2 : Machine.State} : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2 →
      LOpStep k lop L L' → KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2 →
      LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L' (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2))

/-- A kernel simulation run extends along a kernel sequence under the obligations of its steps
(§82 preamble). -/
theorem simRun_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →
      KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 → SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro s2 h _; exact h
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro s2 hs hob
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
    have := ih (SimRun.step hs h hob₁) hob₂
    simp only [ktrace]
    rw [run_append]
    exact this

/-- §82.7 (realization by O1–O16): every translated library run is a translated kernel run of its
kernel steps, with the same parameters, reaching the same kernel and memory states. -/
theorem LSimRun.simRun {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L.kern s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hst hlay hob => exact SimRun.init hst hlay hob
  | step _ hs hob ih => exact simRun_path (kexp_path hs) ih hob

/-- The library states of a translated library run are library-reachable (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
theorem LSimRun.lreach {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) : LReach k statics L := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact .step ih hs.lstep

/-- Simulation of library runs (§82 preamble, §82.7, §9 ¶9): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), for every
translated library run, the memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of `ok`
raw steps, it is related to the kernel state by `Repr`, and the library state is
library-reachable. -/
theorem lsimulation {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty s2) ∧
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2 ∧ LReach k statics L := by
  obtain ⟨hex, hR, -⟩ := simulation hdd hπ h.simRun
  exact ⟨hex, hR, h.lreach⟩

/-- R4 along library runs (§82.5, §54, §57): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), in every state of a
translated library run, every leaf covered by an active authority has a live allocation
containing its range. -/
theorem lsim_r4 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) : LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 :=
  have hs := lsimulation hdd hπ h
  liveCover_reachable hdd h.simRun.staticsOK hs.2.2.ng.reachable hs.2.1

/-! ## No access after invalidation (§82.7, §78, §86) -/

/-- Labelled library runs (Part XIV, §82.7): each library operation listed with the library
state it starts from. -/
inductive LPath (k : K) : LState → List (LOp × LState) → LState → Prop where
  | nil (L : LState) : LPath k L [] L
  | cons {lop : LOp} {L L₁ L' : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} :
      exact hd ((hk.trans hk').active_back (usedAuth_active hst hv) hj)
    · exact ih (hk.trans (lstep_akeep hs.lstep)) q hq hv

/-- No access after invalidation (§82.7, §78, §86): after a legal `reset` of entry `i`, along
every continuation of the library run, no kernel step reads, writes or writes in shared mode
through, stores, or derives or splits from an authority derived from `internal` that covered a
leaf of the administered storage; so none of the raw operations of the continuation realizes an
access through it. -/
theorem reset_no_access {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
    (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) {j : Nat} (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j)
    (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
    ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  have hjL : j < L.kern.A.length := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl, -⟩ := hc
    cases hlj : L.kern.A[j]? with
    | none => simp [S3.afp, hlj] at hl
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hlj
  exact lpath_unused ((lstep_akeep (k := k) (.reset hr)).lt hjL) (reset_ends_covering hE hr hj hc)
    hp (akeep_of_eq rfl)

/-- No access through an issued block after a legal reset of its arena (§82.7, §78, §86): for a
live entry satisfying `EntryInv`, after a legal `reset`, along every continuation of the library
run, no kernel step uses a block issued before the reset on a nonempty region. -/
theorem reset_no_access_issued {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hinv : EntryInv L.kern E)

def ParamsOK {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params Ty) : Prop :=
  PlacementOK π.pl ∧ GeomOK π.geom ∧ ∀ r, C (π.rtok r) (π.rtok r)

/-- The raw operations realizing a kernel step from `s3`, the memory state being `s2` (§82
preamble; §82.2–§82.5): computed from the parameters and the two states, nothing chosen per
step. -/
def opsOf {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : KOp → S3 → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps π.L π.ty s2 s3 src dst
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok s3
  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L π.ty ls
  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .free p auth, _, _ => freeOps π.L p auth
  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty s3 a p
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- Obligations of one step (§20.3, §82): the parametric obligations of its reads and writes
(§20.3, §15, §16); the layout of new places (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, §82.1, §23 `LayoutWF`); the
instantiation of `K.FreeCompat` on the deallocation compatibility of the machine (`free`, §80,
§70.2, §82.4). -/
def StepObl {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Prop :=
  OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2) ∧
    match op with
    | .enter _ ls => NewLayout π.L (enterP s3 ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .alloc _ ow ls => NewLayout π.L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom
        (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .free p auth => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.rtok p auth
    | _ => True

/-- Realization of every kernel step (§82 preamble, R6): under the obligations of the parameters,
`Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling` (parts of the kernel invariant `KInv`, §57) and the obligations of
the step, the raw operations of the step form an execution of `ok` raw steps, and `Repr` holds
after the step. -/
theorem r6 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hnd : NoDangling s3)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) ∧
      Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpl, hg, htc⟩ := hπ
  obtain ⟨hob, hx⟩ := hob
  cases op with
  | derive => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_derive hR h⟩
  | split => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_split hR h⟩
  | release => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_release hR h⟩
  | transfer => exact r6_transfer hR hw h hob
  | depend => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_depend hR h⟩
  | enter => exact r6_enter hR hw h hpl hg hx
  | exit =>
    have := r6_exit (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hR hw h htc
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | read =>
    have := r6_read (C := C) hR hw h hob
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | write => exact r2_write hR hw h hob
  | writeShared => exact r2_writeShared hR hw h hob
  | pin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_pin hR h⟩
  | unpin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_unpin hR h⟩
  | endUse => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_endUse hR h⟩
  | free =>
    have := r6_free (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hR hw hnd h hx
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | alloc => exact (r6_alloc hR hw h hpl hg hx).2
  | store => exact r6_store hR hw h hob

/-! ## Simulation (§82 preamble) -/

/-- Runs of the kernel from `S3.init statics` translated into the memory machine, with the
contract `K`, the deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters
`π` fixed once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the initial state with the creations and writes of the
statics (`repr_init`); then each `ok` kernel step under its obligations (`StepObl`), followed by
its raw operations. No invariant is assumed on the states of the run: they are reachable, so the
kernel invariant holds on them (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
inductive SimRun {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Ty) :
    S3 → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (S3.init statics)
        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))
  | step {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →
      OpStep k op s3 s3' → StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2 →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))

/-- The statics of a translated run are well formed (§47; `SimRun.init`). -/
theorem SimRun.staticsOK {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2) : StaticsOK statics := by
  induction h with
  | init hst _ _ => exact hst
  | step _ _ _ ih => exact ih

/-- Simulation (§82 preamble, §57, §9 ¶9): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), for every translated run, the
memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of `ok` raw steps, it is related to
the kernel state by `Repr` (admissibility included), and the kernel state is reachable from
`S3.init statics` by the kernel steps O1–O16. -/
theorem simulation {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty s2) ∧ Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 ∧
      Access.Reachable k statics s3 := by
  have hst := h.staticsOK
  induction h with
  | init hst hlay hob =>
    obtain ⟨hex, hR⟩ := repr_init (C := C) hst hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hlay hob
    exact ⟨⟨_, hex⟩, hR, .init⟩
  | step _ hs hob ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨ops, hex⟩, hR, hr⟩ := ih
    have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := r6 hπ hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hs hob
    exact ⟨⟨_, exec_append hex hex'⟩, hR', .step hr hs.kstep⟩

/-! ## Pinned addresses (§82.6, §74, §75) -/

/-- The automatic storage deallocated by `exitFrame` dies with the frame (§73): every place of
`exitRoots` is usable before the exit and not after. -/
theorem exitRoots_dies {s3 : S3} (hw : WF3 s3) (hF : s3.F ≠ []) {r : Nat}
    (hr : r ∈ exitRoots s3) :
    s3.Usable r ∧ ¬ ({ s3 with F := s3.F.tail } : S3).Usable r := by
  obtain ⟨hrt, ho, hd⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hr
  cases hpl : s3.P[r]? with
  | none => rw [hpl] at ho; exact ho.elim
/-- Decidability of the preconditions of a kernel operation (§60–§75). -/
instance opPreDec (op : KOp) (s : S3) : Decidable (OpPre k op s) := by
  cases op <;> unfold OpPre <;> infer_instance

variable {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params Ty)

/-- Decidability of the obligations of a step (§20.3, §82). -/
instance stepOblDec (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Decidable (StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) := by
  unfold StepObl; cases op <;> dsimp only <;> infer_instance

/-- One translated step: when the preconditions and the obligations hold, the effect of the step
and the memory state after its raw operations (§82). -/
def sstep (st : S3 × Machine.State) (op : KOp) : Option (S3 × Machine.State) :=
  if OpPre k op st.1 ∧ StepObl k C ObR ObW π op st.1 st.2
  then some (opEff3 op st.1, run st.2 (opsOf π op st.1 st.2)) else none

/-- A translated run of a list of operations, in order (§82). -/
def srun : S3 × Machine.State → List KOp → Option (S3 × Machine.State)
  | st, [] => some st
  | st, op :: ops => (sstep k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops

end Runner

/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun` (§82 preamble). -/
theorem srun_sound {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
    [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone]
    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)]
    [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)] {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    [DecidableRel C] {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty}
    [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] {π : Params Ty} {statics : Statics} :
    ∀ (ops : List KOp) (st st' : S3 × Machine.State),
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π st.1 st.2 → srun k C ObR ObW π st ops = some st' →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π st'.1 st'.2
  | [], st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [srun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact h
  | op :: ops, st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [srun] at he
    cases hs : sstep k C ObR ObW π st op with
    | none => rw [hs] at he; cases he
which the layout parameter is fixed once (§82). -/
def kernelRun : S3 → List KOp → S3
  | s, [] => s
  | s, op :: ops => kernelRun (opEff3 op s) ops

/-- Initial state of a translated run (§47, `repr_init`). -/
def sinit (statics : Statics) (π : Params Unit) : S3 × Machine.State :=
  (S3.init statics, run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))

/-- Written representation of the runs: byte `i` of leaf `l` is `10 l + i`, no provenance
(§10 ¶4). -/
def wv : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat := fun l i => ((10 * l + i).toUInt8, none)

/-- Address decoded from the range of leaf `l` (§82.3). -/
def decodedAt (π : Params Unit) (s2 : Machine.State) (l : Nat) : Nat :=
  π.pe.decode (bytesOf s2 π.L l)

1	import Ern.Corpus.Runner
2	import Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena
3	
4	/-!
5	# Corpus MM23-H: refinement (test module)
6	
7	The cases of corpus MM23-H of the Jalon 3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md`, §3; non-normative
8	design material), replayed on the reference refinement of
9	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` (§82, Part XIV). This is a test module: no model or
10	library module imports it.
11	
12	Each case is a run from the initial state (§47) translated into the elementary memory machine with
13	the contract, the deallocation compatibility (equality of tokens), the read and write obligations
14	and the parameters fixed once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the test layout `piOf` of
15	`Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs` (each root place in its own allocation, each leaf 8 bytes at 8
16	times its rank, `LayoutWF` established by `Repr`), the placement `topPlacement`, the tokens
17	`100 + r`, the 8-byte reference encoding `pe8`. Runs of kernel operations only are kernel
18	simulation runs (`SimRun`, built by `srun`, conclusions by `simulation`); runs with an arena are
19	library simulation runs (`LSimRun`, built by the runner `lsrun` below, conclusions by
20	`lsimulation`), in which `issue` is the derived library operation (`split` then `store`) and
21	`reset` the derived reset (`derive` then `release`). The reached states are those of these runs
22	(material §0, rule 3). The obtained result is stated with the kernel relation of the step under
23	test, the machine relations of its realized raw operations (`ReadStep`, `WriteStep`,
24	`DeallocStep`, `Exec`) and the bytes read back, all decided by `decide`.
25	
26	Each docstring gives the expected verdict of the material, the obtained one, the class (material
27	§0, rule 5: `R` refinement) and the positive twin of each rejection or `fail` (rule 2). A case
28	whose obtained verdict differs from its expected one, or whose expected verdict has no spec v0
29	source, is kept with its expected verdict and classified; no case is corrected.
30	
31	Address rules of references (decisions of the brief, recorded for §82.3 in `Refinement.ptrAddr`):
32	an empty region has the base of the allocation of its effective anchor, with that allocation as
33	provenance; a nonempty region has the lowest address among its leaves of nonzero size; the
34	destination leaf has the size of a reference (`pe8.size = 8`).
35	
36	Not encoded (classified, material §3 and §6):
37	* MM23-H14, a raw pointer formed before a call and used during the call on the footprint of a
38	  `Modify` parameter: undefined behavior that no safe program constructs; class spec 3 (strong
39	  protection of parameters during the invocation, §72 last paragraph, §81) with the boundary of
40	  §19 (reconstruction of accesses from raw addresses).
41	* MM23-H17, a reference stored into a leaf of zero size: a conditional obligation of specs 4 and
42	  11 (a reference occupies a leaf of pointer size), not a guarantee of the refinement; class
43	  specs 4 and 11 (§81, §82.3 "a single logical leaf with an appropriate representation"). The
44	  pointer-size rule is a hypothesis of `Refinement.pointer_sound_store`.
45	-/
46	
47	namespace Ern.Corpus.MM23H
48	
49	open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
50	  Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena Ern.Corpus

content.content:
installs (§74: its identity is its index among the obligations of the state). -/
abbrev K1 : K := KT { done := [0] } false true

/-- Run R1 (§72, §67, §71, §74, §63, §75, §69, §73): frame 1 with the provider 0 and the values
`v` (1) and `w` (2), 0 and 1 written; storage 3 (one leaf) allocated from 0 for `v` (root
authority 3 held by `v`) and written; 3 pinned (`pin 3` installs the obligation 0, §74);
`transfer(v, w)`; 3 unpinned (`unpin` designates the obligation 0, §75); `endUse(w)`; exit. -/
def r1 : List KOp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0] wv, .write 1 [1] wv, .alloc 0 1 [lf],
  .write 3 [3] wv, .pin 3, .transfer 1 2, .unpin 0, .endUse 2, .exit]

/-- Parameters of R1, fixed once from its final places (§82). -/
def π1 : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init []) r1).P []

/-- State of R1 after its first `n` steps (§82). -/
def st1 (n : Nat) : S3 × Machine.State := kfin K1 [] π1 (r1.take n)

/-- The raw operations realizing `transfer(v, w)` in R1 (§82, §63). -/
def t1 : List (Machine.Op Unit) := opsOf π1 (.transfer 1 2) (st1 6).1 (st1 6).2

/-- **MM23-H03** (material §3, class R). Transfer of a value whose owned storage is pinned.
Expected (material): no machine step on the storage, address unchanged. Obtained: the same.
After six steps of R1 (reached, `Sim`) the storage leaf 3 is pinned by the active obligation 0
(§74); `transfer(v, w)` is `ok` (§63.5: storage merely owned by the source does not prevent it,
§87; §63.9: `w` is usable afterwards); its raw operations are an
execution of `ok` steps (§82), none reads, writes or deallocates the allocation of 3, which is
live before and after them at the same address (§82.6, §74). No rejection, no twin. -/
theorem H03 : Sim K1 [] π1 (st1 6) ∧ (st1 6).1.pin 3 = true ∧
    TransferStep K1 1 2 (st1 6).1 (.ok (transferEff (st1 6).1 1 2)) ∧
    Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW t1 (st1 6).2 (run (st1 6).2 t1) ∧
    (∀ o ∈ t1, opAlloc o ≠ some (π1.L 3).alloc) ∧
    liveOf (st1 6).2 (π1.L 3).alloc = some true ∧
    liveOf (run (st1 6).2 t1) (π1.L 3).alloc = some true ∧
    leafAddr (run (st1 6).2 t1) π1.L 3 = leafAddr (st1 6).2 π1.L 3 :=
  have h := sim (KT.ddSound _ _ _) (by decide) (by decide)
  ⟨h, by decide, .ok (by decide), kexec (KT.ddSound _ _ _) (piOf_ok _ _) h.1 (by decide), by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- **MM23-H04** (material §3, class R). Transfer of a value in place. Expected (material): a read
then a write of the bytes, provenance kept; the source `Moved` and unreadable, its bytes still
initialized. Obtained: the same. From the reached state of H03, the raw operations of
`transfer(v, w)` are a read of the range of `v` then a write of the range of `w` (§82, §63); after
them the range of `w` holds the bytes of `v`, value and provenance (§16 ¶2, §20.2 ¶1), and the
range of `v` is unchanged and initialized; in the kernel the leaf of `v` is `Moved` (§63 effect)
and every read of it is rejected (§66.1). Twin of the rejected read, the same run without the
transfer: the read of `v` is `ok`. The provenance is kept because the realization writes the
bytes it read, provenance included (§16 ¶2, §20.2 ¶1); propagation of provenance through copies is
not fixed by spec v0.1 at the level of the language (§10 ¶4, §19): open boundary of the spec,
non-blocking (arbitration Q22), not a mismatch. -/
theorem H04 : Sim K1 [] π1 (st1 6) ∧ t1.map opKind = [0, 1] ∧
    t1.map opAlloc = [some (π1.L 1).alloc, some (π1.L 2).alloc] ∧
    (∀ i < 8, bytesOf (run (st1 6).2 t1) π1.L 2 i = bytesOf (st1 6).2 π1.L 1 i) ∧
    (∀ i < 8, bytesOf (run (st1 6).2 t1) π1.L 1 i = bytesOf (st1 6).2 π1.L 1 i) ∧
    initOf (run (st1 6).2 t1) π1.L 1 = some true ∧
    (transferEff (st1 6).1 1 2).I 1 = .moved ∧
    (∀ a, Read3Step a [1] (transferEff (st1 6).1 1 2) .reject) ∧
    Read3Step 1 [1] (st1 6).1 (.ok (st1 6).1) :=
  ⟨sim (KT.ddSound _ _ _) (by decide) (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide,
    fun _ => .reject fun hp => absurd (hp.init 1 (List.mem_singleton_self _)) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- **MM23-H08** (material §3, class R). `endUse` of a value whose owned storage is not freed.
Expected (material): no machine step; the allocation stays live (a leak). Obtained: the same.
After eight steps of R1 (reached; the `unpin` of step 8 ended the pinning obligation 0 of the
storage leaf, §75, §69.4), `endUse(w)` is `ok` and realized by no raw operation (§82.5,
§69 effect "does not automatically trigger physical deallocation"); in the kernel the storage 3
is dead and unusable, in the machine its allocation is live, and still live at the end of R1. -/
theorem H08 : Sim K1 [] π1 (st1 8) ∧ Sim K1 [] π1 (st1 10) ∧
    EndUseStep K1 2 (st1 8).1 (.ok (endUseEff (st1 8).1 2)) ∧
    opsOf π1 (.endUse 2) (st1 8).1 (st1 8).2 = [] ∧
    (endUseEff (st1 8).1 2).dead 3 = true ∧ ¬ (endUseEff (st1 8).1 2).Usable 3 ∧
